function.name: search_document

document_id.description: The document_id from the file's card.

query.description: Keywords, exact text, or a regex, depending on mode.

max_results.description: Up to 50 for exact/regex (default 20), up to 200 groups with group_by (default 50), up to 10 passages for keywords (default 5).

context_lines.description: exact/regex only: lines to show before and after each match, 0-5.

from_line.description: Search only from this line on (1-based). Pass a result's next_from_line to see the matches after those it shows.

to_line.description: Search only up to this line.

order.description: exact/regex only: "last" shows the last max_results matching lines (in file order) instead of the first. Defaults to "first".

group_by.description: exact/regex only: count the matching lines by group instead of showing them. "capture": by the text of the regex's first (group); "minute", "hour", "day": by the timestamp on the line; "shape": by the line with its numbers, IDs and quoted values taken out.

whole_word.description: exact only: match the text only as a whole word, not inside a longer one. Defaults to false.
